messages:
liang: Hey everyone — first-day hiccup: I never received the Okta activation SMS (I'm in Shanghai). Tried VPN and a different browser, but enroll shows 'Activation attempt blocked'. Need Google Drive + GitHub access for onboarding. @sam-it @tia-peopleops can you help?

sam-it: Sorry — that sucks. Can you confirm the phone number you used and whether you tried the backup email? Also, what's your public IP (just paste it here or DM)? If SMS is blocked we can generate a one-time admin activation link.

okta-bot: Suspicious sign-in detected for user liang@redwood.ai from IP 119.123.45.67 (CN). MFA enrollment attempts exceeded threshold. Admin override required.

liang: Phone I used is +86 13800001111. IP was my home ISP (119.123.45.67). I tried the browser flow twice, then switched VPN to us-west and got the 'Too many attempts' message. No backup email set up.

sam-it: Got it. I'll ping security and prepare an override. In the meantime I can create a temporary shared Drive folder with links so you can start onboarding docs — link will expire in 24h. Is that acceptable?

tia-peopleops: We can also ship a hardware token (YubiKey) to your address — DM me shipping details and I'll create a shipping ticket. Shipping ETA might be 5–7 business days though.

rix-security: For overrides we should keep the window tight. Sam, can you open an activation window for 15 minutes and require that they complete enrollment from a secure network? Also document the override in the incident tracker for audits.

sam-it: On it. Creating one-time activation link and sending to backup email liang.personal@example.com. Also created temporary Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f (expires in 24h) :lock_with_ink_pen:

liang: I got the Drive link and the one-time activation email — enrollment went through, I can access the folder and started the onboarding checklist. Thanks so much. I'll DM my shipping address for the YubiKey.

rix-security: Quick tip — if enrolling passkeys from China and Safari complains about WebAuthn, try Chrome (desktop) or the latest OS updates. If WebAuthn still fails we can temporarily allow OOB SMS but we'll rotate to a hardware key when it arrives. I'll file a docs note for this edge case.

kelsey-peopleops: Welcome to Redwood, Liang! Ping me if you want a buddy to walk through the first-week checklist. :wave:

sam-it: Reminder: once you're fully enrolled, please remove any open link sharing from that temp folder. We'll also follow up with shipping ETA for the YubiKey.

liang: All sorted for now — enrolled and have access. Thanks everyone! :smile:
